inputs.name: hand over from Acceptance Criteria to Model Evaluation Harness

output.level_0: The evaluation harness crashes before finishing, leaving the team with no results for the new model.
output.level_1: No evaluation harness exists, so the team guesses whether the new model is better than the old one.
output.level_2: A data scientist manually runs evaluation scripts and pastes the metrics into a shared spreadsheet for review.
output.level_4: A formal sign off requires documented evidence that the model meets all acceptance criteria before deployment.
